response.justification: The candidate's experience is heavily skewed toward software development, web/mobile applications, and general IT infrastructure, with no direct evidence of hardware design, SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator optimization, or deep-learning workload analysis. While they demonstrate strong software engineering skills and leadership in open-source projects, these do not align with the principal-level hardware/performance architecture requirements for AI accelerators.
strengths: Extensive full-stack software development experience with multiple languages and frameworks
Strong background in performance optimization for web services and real-time systems
Proven track record of leading open-source projects and technical workshops
concerns: No demonstrated experience with SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, or AI accelerator architectures
Lacks required qualifications in hardware optimization or deep-learning workload analysis
No evidence of work with SIMD/MIMD architectures or GPU optimization
